guidelines.detail: refines ACT-07 (The description explicitly conditions the employer's report on whether emergency services have already been notified. The reported gateway has one incoming and one outgoing flow, so it does not represent that decision. ACT-07 already advises using a gateway for a decision; this guideline refines it by specifying that a conditional action needs alternative paths.)
kept for this example only, tied to it by: route

same as LRN-003 (The description distinguishes reporting duties by trigger, recipient, and deadline, while the generated labels do not consistently preserve those distinctions. The reference label paired with P1 conflicts with the description, so it is not used as support. LRN-003 already covers labeling actions and outcomes without broadening, narrowing, or adding unsupported detail.)

same as LRN-049 (The description makes the reporting action conditional on whether it has already been reported to emergency services, while the recorded gateway has only one incoming and one outgoing flow. The learned guideline LRN-049 already addresses this modeling error.)

same as LRN-032 (The description identifies different incident categories and reporting obligations, while the records show the corresponding decision gateway and transitions are absent. The guideline expresses the same decision-and-branching principle as LRN-032.)

same as LRN-016 (The description states distinct reporting conditions and criteria, while the generated gateway labels substitute unrelated or less precise criteria. LRN-016 already says labels should preserve stated meaning rather than substitute different meaning.)

refines FID-01 (The description specifies distinct reporting duties with different recipients, conditions, and deadlines, including a report required even if another report has already been made. The cited flow records show divergence from the reference's separate reporting paths. This refines the broad instruction to model every stated branch by clarifying how independent reporting obligations should be represen)

same as LRN-016 (The label pairs show that relevant distinctions in the described notifications and decision criteria were broadened or changed. The learned guideline LRN-016 already calls for labels that preserve stated action, object, actor, or recipient details without substituting another meaning.)

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description makes an action conditional on whether a stated condition holds: Model the condition as a control-flow decision with alternative outgoing paths, so the action is taken only on the applicable path; do not use a gateway with only one incoming and one outgoing sequence flow.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description makes an action conditional on whether a stated condition holds

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states that a shared notification can concern different kinds of occurrences and that the follow-up handling depends on the occurrence kind or its attributes.: Model an exclusive gateway after the shared notification to route each case to its applicable follow-up path.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states that a shared notification can concern different kinds of occurrences and that the follow-up handling depends on the occurrence kind or its attributes.

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description names a distinct activity or outcome and states its action or completion condition: Label the corresponding BPMN element with the described action or outcome. Do not replace it with a broader or narrower action, or add detail the description does not support.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states a duty or decision with a stated condition, recipient, or time limit

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states a decision with multiple distinct outcomes: Model the decision as a gateway and connect it by a sequence flow to every described outcome branch.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description distinguishes categories of incidents and assigns different follow-up actions or obligations according to the category

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states an activity or outcome and identifies its action, object, actor, or recipient: label the corresponding BPMN element with concise wording that preserves those stated details and does not substitute a different action or meaning
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states an activity or decision with a distinguishing actor, condition, recipient, or timing.

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description assigns separate reports to different recipients or states that one report is required regardless of whether another report occurred: model each required report on its own control-flow path, retaining its stated applicability and timing
rules_sent_back.situation: the description assigns separate reports to different recipients or states that one report is required regardless of whether another report occurred
